sources.snippet: Swift-Qwen3.8-27B Swift-Qwen3.8-27B is UkisAI's reasoning-efficient derivative of Qwen3.8-27B, using 58.3% fewer thinking tokens while maintaining near-identical performance (<1% loss) and as a result getting a x1.95 speed-up on several tasks.
